About The Artist

About Sayali Banode

Welcome! I'm Sayali Banode, a professional makeup artist dedicated to enhancing natural beauty and creating confidence in every client. With years of experience in bridal, party, and editorial makeup, I bring artistry, precision, and a personalized touch to every look I create.

Whether it's your dream wedding day, a festive celebration, or a high-fashion shoot, I specialize in skin-first, camera-ready techniques using only high-end international cosmetics to ensure your look lasts all day and night.
